items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Charlotte was Frank. [INTERVIEWEE] I see

ctx.x: If I'm not mistaken, he still had Frank Troll I think, didn't he?
He might have. I know Charlotte was Frank.

I see, to give you an example, in my hometown, the first time we heard Goodman was at a dance in my hometown, playing for Skidmore College. It just had been booked up there. And all the local musicians were around behind the bandstand. Krupa was with him then, and Frank Frobot, I distinctly remember that that night, Helen Ward.
